accounting: NEW16/OLD1, 42 anchors, .75 child/.25 anchor per rank; add actual logical optimizer steps and actual target tokens, not presentations as optimizer steps.
algorithm: Average-gradient batch8 AdamW, NOT serial-equivalent; partial tail averages active ranks only.
deadlines: Immutable minimum of activation, all8 TRAIN/lease bounds and 17:00UTC; hard ceiling17:02UTC; reserve for commit; no sliding deadlines.
hook_signature: consolidate(root, activation_path, activation_sha256, branch, engine, optimizer, group, anchor_module, anchors, anchor_root, save_checkpoint, check): keyword-only; all8 call collectively
owner_callback: def save(destination, generation, metrics): original.checkpoint(engine, SAME_optimizer, destination, sleeps+1, cycle); return consolidation.reference(destination)

owner_hooks.F1: Pass the SAME existing AdamW and original save_checkpoint(destination,generation,metrics) callback; do not reconstruct optimizer.
owner_hooks.Main: Create pinned activation after serial commit/readouts and all8 safe handoffs; never during START without COMPLETE.
owner_hooks.after_return: All8 in-place LoRA broadcasts verified; collective reload ACKs durable before return. Owners retain fresh-process DEV/FINAL/open scheduling.
owner_hooks.all8: Keep raw engine/LoRA objects and RNG; stop collection at two-episode submission barrier; supply live process identity and safe certificate.
owner_hooks.committed_restart: Only at an idle common boundary: restore_committed restores adapter and existing F1 optimizer in place plus each saved rank RNG; never during an unfinished sleep.
owner_hooks.failure: No retry/reset/replay. Preserve START, UPDATES, sidecars and FAILED. Only recover_complete may repair COMPLETE->STATE without training.
owner_hooks.group: Caller-owned Gloo group, rank order F1..A4, finite timeout <=180s, no fork of CUDA engines.
owner_hooks.rows: Each rank runs pinned prepare_native_cohort against identical COMMON and original F1 anchor order; native prefix masking unchanged.
owner_hooks.workers: Pass optimizer=None and save_checkpoint=None; no optimizer allocation.

owner_integration_still_required: Owner-specific future successor hooks to preserve safe release/current cursor (route/code/grid/math), no implicit first-sleep seam.
Caller-created finite-timeout Gloo process group and SAME F1 raw optimizer; never fork already-loaded CUDA engines.
Main creates future activation pins after all8 verified safe; current serial and CONFIG remain unchanged.
Owners maintain strict guard/FINAL binding and fresh-process readouts. No changes to current family modules in this delivery.
partial_failure_contract: START and completed step receipts remain; FAILED prohibits rerun. No retry/reset/regeneration. Only COMPLETE publication recovery can advance STATE without optimizer work. If uncommitted partial state is lost, leave it failed; any further recovery needs explicit owner design, not silent replay.
participant_note: participants maps branch to {path,sha256}; preserved_files maps root-relative ledgers/CARRY/cursors to hashes, owner-produced at boundary; identity is live boot_id/pid/start_ticks.
predecessor_loading: Before entry, F1 owner loads current committed adapter/optimizer into its raw engine and existing AdamW. Entry verifies actual adapter tensors and complete optimizer state against COMMON checkpoint. No optimizer is constructed here; objects remain identical during all updates/reloads.
publication: Original CHECKPOINT.json and optimizer_rng.pt keys preserved; hashed PARALLEL_RNG.pt and all8 manifest added in one renamed checkpoint directory, then COMPLETE, then STATE.
rank_rng: On successful completion all8 resident engines already contain the broadcast committed adapter; RNG remains rank-local. Explicit restore_committed at an idle committed boundary reuses parameter/optimizer objects and restores all8 saved RNG. It rejects a generation with START or no matching COMPLETE; not partial-sleep replay.
safe_certificate_rule: Family owners, not this candidate, establish completed DEV + settled cursor/charge boundary and authenticate CARRY/ledger files. Candidate verifies bound hashes, live PID identities, caps and all8 exact submissions, but does not infer family-specific ledger semantics.
source_pin_rule: Include full immutable source closure and exact owner save-hook source file. prepare_native_cohort additionally requires pinned shared/replay/anchor/policy modules. Hash native source archives; never point live actors at this candidate before Main activation.
